John has been teaching tennis for over 20 years. He is 4.5 pickleball player and has been teaching pickleball for 5 years. John has taught at numerous clubs throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, and California. John has also been the Tennis/Pickleball Director at Abbey Springs Country Club since 2006.
